brief.meaningEn: Make an interaction or relationship feel less sharp, tense or divided without necessarily removing all differences.
brief.meaningZh: 使互動或關係較不尖銳、疏離，但不一定消除所有分歧。
brief.grammar: Something can soften the edges between groups or of a tense exchange; the object edges is figurative.
brief.register: Reflective community discussion; a workshop organiser describes how working side by side eased tension between groups.
brief.boundaryZh: 緩和隔閡不代表雙方已完全同意或過去衝突消失。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是磨平物件邊角；單純同處一室而沒有互動，也不足以說隔閡緩和。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出哪種共同互動使關係較柔和，以及尚存的分歧。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 185, row 7; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Shared work can soften the edges between groups.

listening.en: Two neighbourhood groups had argued over garden space. After repairing the shared fence together, they still disagreed about planting but spoke more easily; the work helped soften the edges.
listening.zh: 兩個社區團體曾因花園空間爭執。一起修好共用圍欄後，他們對種植安排仍有分歧，卻較能平心靜氣地交談；合作幫助緩和了彼此的隔閡。
listening.promptZh: soften the edges 在這裏表示甚麼？

options.en: The shared work eased tension between the groups.
options.zh: 共同工作緩和了兩團體之間的緊張。

options.en: Repairing the fence settled every dispute about planting.
options.zh: 修好圍欄便解決了所有種植爭議。

options.en: The groups became closer only because they changed the fence design.
options.zh: 兩團體關係改善純因改了圍欄設計。

options.en: They still refused to speak after completing the repair.
options.zh: 完成維修後，他們仍拒絕交談。

listening.explanationZh: 仍有分歧，但溝通變得較容易。

reply.promptEn: Did the artists from the two studios settle their funding dispute? Not yet. They jointly hosted an open day, and now they can discuss the dispute without immediately arguing.
reply.promptZh: （兩間工作室的藝術家解決了資助爭議嗎？還沒有。他們合辦開放日，現在能討論爭議而不會立即吵起來。）

options.en: The joint event made their exchanges less tense.
options.zh: 合辦活動令雙方交流較不緊張。

options.en: They can now talk despite the unresolved dispute.
options.zh: 爭議未解，他們現在仍能交談。

options.en: The shared open day helped soften the edges.
options.zh: 合辦開放日有助緩和彼此的隔閡。

options.en: Their relationship is less abrasive even though they disagree.
options.zh: 雖仍有分歧，彼此關係卻沒有那麼尖銳。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均承認爭議未解，只是互動緩和。

scene.promptZh: 兩支辯論隊爭執後共同籌辦比賽，仍不同意規則，但彼此開始耐心聽完對方說話。哪句貼切？

options.en: Working together helped soften the edges.
options.zh: 合作幫助緩和彼此的隔閡。

options.en: The teams now agree on every rule.
options.zh: 兩隊現在同意所有規則。

options.en: The teams were always on good terms, so nothing changed.
options.zh: 兩隊一直友好，因此沒有任何改變。

scene.explanationZh: 態度較緩和，但分歧仍在。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以支持 soften the edges between groups？

options.en: Members listen and speak more calmly after a shared project.
options.zh: 共同計劃後，成員較願聆聽，也較平和地交談。

options.en: The two groups stay in separate rooms and never interact.
options.zh: 兩團體分處不同房間，從未互動。

options.en: A joint meal makes future discussion less hostile.
options.zh: 共同用餐令日後討論不再那麼敵對。

contrast.explanationZh: 沒有互動或關係變化的證據。

dialogue.promptZh: 有人說：「soften the edges 意味所有分歧已解決。」哪句更準確？

options.en: Working together can soften the edges while disagreement remains.
options.zh: 合作可緩和彼此的隔閡，而分歧仍在。

options.en: It guarantees full agreement.
options.zh: 它保證完全同意。

options.en: Joint work matters only if it ends every disagreement.
options.zh: 合作必須結束所有分歧才有作用。

dialogue.explanationZh: 緩和關係不等於全面解決爭端。

speaking.en: A joint cooking session helped soften the edges between the rival teams; they still competed, but they stopped insulting one another.
speaking.zh: 共同烹飪讓兩支對立隊伍的隔閡稍為緩和；他們仍然競爭，卻不再互相辱罵。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出兩隊仍做甚麼，以及停止做甚麼。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：兩個志願團隊曾為倉庫使用時間爭執；他們一起整理物資一週後，仍未同意時段安排，卻能平靜開會。用英文說明合作帶來的有限改變。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出倉庫時間爭議、合作一週、時段未達共識、現在可平靜開會。

examples.en: A week of sorting supplies together helped soften the edges between the volunteer teams: they still disagree about warehouse hours but can now meet calmly.
examples.zh: 兩個義工團隊一起整理物資一週，有助緩和彼此的隔閡：他們對倉庫使用時間仍有分歧，現在卻能平靜開會。

examples.en: The volunteers worked together on supplies for a week, which helped soften the edges of their relationship. Their warehouse timetable dispute remains, although meetings are calmer.
examples.zh: 義工一起整理物資一週，這有助緩和彼此關係的隔閡。倉庫時間表的爭議仍未解決，但會議較平和。

takeaways.en: Soften the edges means ease a relationship’s sharpness or tension.
takeaways.zh: 緩和隔閡，指使關係或互動較不尖銳。

takeaways.en: To soften the edges is not necessarily to settle every disagreement.
takeaways.zh: 緩和隔閡不一定等於解決所有分歧。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending. Guide-written source provenance; newly written practice. No human or release approval is implied.

brief.meaningEn: Promoted with expectations that exceed what the event or product delivers.
brief.meaningZh: 宣傳所造成的期望高於實際表現。
brief.grammar: Overhyped is an adjective, often after be/seem or before a noun; it evaluates the gap between publicity and experience.
brief.register: Informal review and media discussion; a festival visitor compares advertising promises with the actual event.
brief.boundaryZh: 人氣高不等於宣傳過度；須有宣傳承諾與實際體驗的落差。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不等於活動一定很差，也不能只因自己不喜歡便說 overhyped。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出具體宣傳聲稱與實際結果的差距。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 187, row 5; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Some viewers found the event overhyped.

listening.en: The festival adverts promised six live stages, but only two opened and the rest were recorded screens. Several visitors found the event overhyped.
listening.zh: 節慶廣告承諾有六個現場舞台，實際只有兩個開放，其餘只是播放錄影片段的螢幕。多名訪客覺得活動宣傳過度。

options.en: The advertising raised expectations beyond what was delivered.
options.zh: 宣傳所造成的期望高於實際安排。

options.en: Visitors received all six live stages exactly as advertised.
options.zh: 訪客得到廣告所說的全部六個現場舞台。

options.en: The adverts mentioned two live stages and visitors found two.
options.zh: 廣告說有兩個現場舞台，訪客亦見到兩個。

options.en: The smaller live programme was clearly stated before tickets were sold.
options.zh: 售票前已清楚說明現場節目規模較小。

listening.explanationZh: 承諾六個現場舞台，實際只有兩個。

reply.promptEn: Why did the guests criticise the hotel’s “panoramic rooftop tour”? The brochure showed an hour-long guided visit, but guests received a ten-minute stop behind a high wall.
reply.promptZh: （住客為何批評酒店所稱的「全景天台導賞」？小冊子展示一小時的導賞，實際只讓住客在高牆後停留十分鐘。）

options.en: The advertised tour sounded much better than the delivered one.
options.zh: 宣傳中的導賞比實際提供的好得多。

options.en: The brochure set expectations the brief stop did not meet.
options.zh: 小冊子的宣傳令住客期望高於實際。

options.en: The rooftop tour was overhyped.
options.zh: 天台導賞宣傳過度。

options.en: Guests compared an hour-long promise with ten minutes behind a wall.
options.zh: 住客比較了一小時的承諾與高牆後的十分鐘。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都指出承諾與實際導賞有落差。

scene.promptZh: 展覽廣告主打可操作的十件機器，開幕後只有兩件可操作，其餘只是照片。哪句貼切？

options.en: The exhibition was overhyped.
options.zh: 展覽宣傳過度。

options.en: All ten promised machines were available to try.
options.zh: 承諾的十件機器全部可以操作。

options.en: The advert described a photo display rather than working machines.
options.zh: 廣告描述的是照片展覽，而非可操作的機器。

scene.explanationZh: 實際可操作的機器遠少於宣傳承諾。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以證明某活動 overhyped？

options.en: The advert promises a workshop but attendees get only a brochure.
options.zh: 廣告承諾有工作坊，參加者卻只收到小冊子。

options.en: The event is popular and exactly matches its modest description.
options.zh: 活動很受歡迎，亦完全符合其平實描述。

options.en: The “all-day” session lasts only twenty minutes.
options.zh: 所稱「全日」活動只持續二十分鐘。

contrast.explanationZh: 受歡迎而如實宣傳，並無落差。

dialogue.promptZh: 評論者說：「我不喜歡音樂，所以演唱會一定 overhyped。」哪句回應較準確？

options.en: To call it overhyped, compare the promotional claims with what the concert actually delivered.
options.zh: 要說演唱會宣傳過度，應比較宣傳聲稱與實際提供的內容。

options.en: Disliking a genre alone proves overhyping.
options.zh: 單是不喜歡曲風就證明宣傳過度。

options.en: A concert is overhyped whenever one listener dislikes its genre.
options.zh: 只要一名聽眾不喜歡曲風，演唱會就算宣傳過度。

dialogue.explanationZh: 評價這個詞需要宣傳與實際之間的證據。

speaking.en: The “hands-on” science fair felt overhyped when visitors discovered that every machine was behind glass and could only be watched.
speaking.zh: 訪客發現科學展所有機器都隔着玻璃，只能觀看，因此覺得所稱的「動手體驗」宣傳過度。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出「動手體驗」和實際安排的落差。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：餐廳宣傳一個有五道菜的現場烹飪晚宴；入場後只有兩道菜現場烹調，其餘三道預先做好。你仍喜歡食物。用英文解釋為何部分宣傳過度，而不要說整晚一無是處。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出宣傳五道現場烹調、實際只有兩道、三道預製、食物仍好吃；聚焦宣傳落差。

examples.en: The dinner was overhyped as a five-course live cooking event: only two dishes were prepared in front of guests, while three were made beforehand, though the food tasted good.
examples.zh: 晚宴宣傳為五道菜現場烹調，實際只有兩道在賓客面前製作，另外三道預先做好；雖然食物好吃，宣傳仍有過度之處。

examples.en: Although I enjoyed the food, the live-cooking claim felt overhyped. The restaurant promised five dishes cooked before us, but prepared only two live and served three premade dishes.
examples.zh: 雖然我喜歡食物，現場烹調的宣傳仍令人覺得過度。餐廳承諾五道菜都在我們面前烹調，卻只現場做兩道，另外三道是預製的。

takeaways.en: Overhyped means publicity created expectations the experience did not meet.
takeaways.zh: 宣傳過度，指宣傳製造的期望高於實際體驗。

takeaways.en: A popular event is not overhyped if it delivers what it promises.
takeaways.zh: 活動受歡迎而又符合宣傳承諾，未必是宣傳過度。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending. Guide-written source provenance; newly written practice. No human or release approval is implied.

lessons.titleEn: too much of a good thing

brief.meaningEn: An enjoyable or beneficial thing can become tiring or less useful when there is too much of it.
brief.meaningZh: 原本令人喜歡或有益的事，過量後也可能使人疲倦或失去益處。
brief.grammar: Too much of a good thing is a fixed noun phrase; often use can be / is too much of a good thing.
brief.register: Everyday opinion and media discussion; a viewer explains why repeated coverage of a favourite event becomes tiring.
brief.boundaryZh: 批評的是份量或頻率，不一定否定事情本身。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是說這件事從一開始就不好，也不等於所有人承受量一樣。
brief.outcomeZh: 能同時承認原本的好處，指出過量造成的具體問題。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 187, row 8; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Two weeks of coverage can feel like too much of a good thing.
sources.expression: too much of a good thing

listening.en: Mina enjoys travel programmes, but four hours of the same destination each evening left her tired of it. She said it was too much of a good thing.
listening.zh: 米娜喜歡旅遊節目，但每晚四小時都看同一個目的地，令她看得疲倦。她說這是好事過量反成負擔。
listening.promptZh: too much of a good thing 表示甚麼？

options.en: Something enjoyable became tiring in excessive amounts.
options.zh: 原本有趣的事因份量過多而令人疲倦。

options.en: Mina disliked travel programmes before this week.
options.zh: 米娜在本週之前已不喜歡旅遊節目。

options.en: The four hours each evening made her want more of the same destination.
options.zh: 每晚四小時的節目令她還想看更多同一目的地內容。

options.en: She was tired because the programmes contained no travel content.
options.zh: 她疲倦是因節目沒有旅遊內容。

listening.explanationZh: 她本來喜歡，卻因每晚四小時的重複內容而疲倦。

reply.promptEn: Why did the club shorten its popular tasting session? Members loved trying new teas, but after sampling thirty in one sitting they could no longer notice the differences.
reply.promptZh: （學會為何縮短熱門品茶環節？會員喜歡試新茶，但一口氣品嚐三十款後已分不出差別。）

options.en: The large number reduced the value of an enjoyable activity.
options.zh: 過多數量降低了有趣活動的價值。

options.en: Members still liked tea but needed a smaller session.
options.zh: 會員仍喜歡茶，只是需要較短的活動。

options.en: Thirty samples were too much of a good thing.
options.zh: 三十款樣本令好事過量反成負擔。

options.en: The club kept the activity but cut its excess.
options.zh: 學會保留活動，同時減少過量安排。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都承認品茶有趣，只是三十款太多。

scene.promptZh: 讀書會喜歡作者訪談，但一天安排十二場，參加者後來已難以集中。哪句貼切？

options.en: The interviews became too much of a good thing.
options.zh: 訪談變成好事過量反成負擔。

options.en: The interviews had no value to the club even in small numbers.
options.zh: 訪談即使少量安排，對讀書會也毫無價值。

options.en: Twelve interviews left everyone more focused at the end.
options.zh: 十二場訪談過後，所有人更能集中。

scene.explanationZh: 好處仍在，但頻率過高使人難以集中。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情境最不符合 too much of a good thing？

options.en: A helpful reminder appears so often that users stop reading it.
options.zh: 有用提示出現太頻繁，以致用戶不再閱讀。

options.en: A pleasant concert is repeated so many times in one day that listeners tire.
options.zh: 好聽的音樂會一天重複太多次，聽眾漸感疲倦。

options.en: A machine is faulty and unsafe from its first use.
options.zh: 機器從首次使用起就故障且不安全。

contrast.explanationZh: 這不是原本的好處因過量而減弱。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「這句話代表那件事完全不好。」哪句回應較準確？

options.en: Too much of a good thing still begins with something valued; the excess causes the problem.
options.zh: 好事過量反成負擔，前提是那件事原本有價值，問題在於過量。

options.en: It means the activity has always been harmful.
options.zh: 它指活動一直有害。

options.en: The phrase means there was too little of a valued activity.
options.zh: 這片語表示有價值的活動太少。

dialogue.explanationZh: 片語同時承認好處與過量造成的弊端。

speaking.en: The weekly art updates were useful, but ten alerts a day became too much of a good thing and members muted the channel.
speaking.zh: 每週的藝術消息本來有用，但每天十則通知就變成好事過量反成負擔，成員於是把頻道設為靜音。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出成員做了甚麼以及原因。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區博物館每週一次的免費導賞廣受歡迎，於是改為每天六場；導賞仍然有用，但義工一天重複同一內容六次後疲憊，訪客亦感到場次過密。用英文提出減少場次，而不是取消導賞。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出原本每週一場受歡迎、現每天六場、義工疲倦、訪客覺得過密，建議減少而非取消。

examples.en: The free tours became too much of a good thing when the museum moved from one popular weekly tour to six a day: volunteers grew tired of repeating it and visitors felt overwhelmed, so it should reduce the number.
examples.zh: 免費導賞由每週一場熱門活動增至每天六場後，便成了好事過量反成負擔：義工因重複講解而疲倦，訪客也覺得過密，因此博物館應減少場次。

examples.en: A weekly free tour was popular, but six tours a day were too much of a good thing. The same material wore out volunteers and overwhelmed visitors; the museum could offer fewer tours rather than cancel them.
examples.zh: 每週一次的免費導賞本來很受歡迎，但每天六場就好事過量反成負擔。重複講解使義工疲倦，也令訪客覺得過密；博物館可減少場次，而非取消導賞。

takeaways.en: Too much of a good thing means excess can make a benefit less enjoyable.
takeaways.zh: 好事過量反成負擔，指過量使原本的好處變得不那麼可取。

takeaways.en: Too much of a good thing criticises the amount, not necessarily the thing itself.
takeaways.zh: 好事過量反成負擔，批評的是份量，不一定否定事情本身。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending. Guide-written source provenance; newly written practice. No human or release approval is implied.
